intention: Show the power bank as an integrated part of daily mobility gear—resting on a functional urban textile surface, its compact form and integrated cables echoing the smart, no-fuss design of modern outerwear.
visible_link: The two fixed integrated cables—looped and pendant—mirror the look of drawstrings or stowed straps on a technical jacket, reinforcing that everything needed is already in place, without clutter.
reason_to_care: For people constantly on the move, this battery solves the daily friction of forgotten cables and bulky chargers: it’s ready, self-contained, and designed to travel with you like a trusted pocket accessory.
audience_use: People who rely heavily on their smartphones and spend most of their day moving between work, study, and outings—needing reliable, cable-free charging without adding bulk or hassle.
product_nature: A compact, satin-finish light blue power bank (20 000 mAh, 45W), rectangular with softly rounded corners, featuring a digital display showing 100%, two visible ports (USB-C and orange USB-A) on top, and two fixed integrated blue braided cables—one looped above, one hanging below—exactly as photographed.
idea: A close-up of a folded technical fabric surface in cool grey-blue, resembling a lightweight urban jacket, with the battery resting slightly tilted as if slipped into an exterior pocket, lit softly from the left to highlight texture and product finish.
structure: Vertical composition with the folded fabric occupying the lower two-thirds, creating a clean plane; the battery sits on the upper edge of the fold, angled toward the viewer, leaving open space on the right for text reserve; no background elements, no depth tricks—just material, product, and negative space.
setting: A single piece of soft, matte technical fabric in cool grey-blue, folded once to form a flat platform, evoking a modern city jacket’s inner lining or exterior pocket flap—no seams, no logos, no hardware visible.
materials: Matte, non-reflective technical textile with fine woven texture, dyed in a cool neutral tone that complements the product’s light blue satin finish without competing; no leather, metal, or synthetic sheen.
atmosphere: Calm, urban-ready utility—like stepping out with everything you need already in place, no last-minute scrambling, just quiet confidence in your kit.
light: Soft, diffused studio light coming from the left, matching the photograph’s lighting direction, casting a gentle shadow to the right of the battery and emphasizing the fabric’s texture and the product’s rounded edges without harsh contrast.

text_reserve.description: A smooth, untextured vertical band of near-black, calm and deep, offering strong contrast for white headline text without visual noise.

elements.element: Folded technical fabric surface, cool grey-blue, matte, with subtle weave texture
Battery resting on the fold, slightly inclined, cables in fixed photographed pose

resolution: No resolution needed—the concept fits the product’s real appearance and constraints exactly; the scene requires no adjustment to accommodate the fixed cable positions or lighting.
placement_why: Left-third close framing centers attention on the product’s form and integrated cables while leaving ample right-side space for the headline reserve; the tilt mimics natural placement in a pocket, reinforcing the ‘already there, ready to go’ idea.
headline: Ce qu’il te faut, déjà dedans.
headline_role: Reinforces the visual metaphor: the battery is not carried separately but belongs naturally in your everyday gear, like a pocket feature—no extra steps, no missing parts.

palette_roles.surfaces: Folded fabric surface, covering most of the midground
Text reserve zone on the right, providing contrast and calm
Subtle undertone in fabric shadow areas, grounding the cool palette
Highlight reflections on the battery’s satin surface and display bezel

choices.why: Vertical close framing on left third emphasizes the product’s compactness and integrates it into a wearable context; the fold creates a natural ‘pocket’ illusion without adding props or misleading cues.
Tilted placement on the fabric fold mirrors how one might casually slip the battery into a jacket pocket—suggesting ease of access and integration, while respecting the fixed cable pose.
Matching the photograph’s left-side soft lighting ensures visual continuity and highlights the satin finish and cable texture without creating false shadows or reflections.
Using COOL_GREY as dominant keeps focus on the product’s light blue; NEAR_BLACK reserve ensures headline legibility; STEEL_NAVY adds depth without warmth, aligning with HABB’s cool, local identity.
Right-column near-black reserve offers maximum contrast for white text, stays clear of the product, and uses minimal space—honoring the ‘no clutter, just what you need’ message.
